title: Cargo-Scrip Fence
text: Cargo-Scrip Fence swaps route permits for forged cargo claims and attacks when either document is questioned. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.

defeatReward.text: Cargo-Scrip Fence is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.

imagePrompt: Original Ashen Reach enemy card art of Cargo-Scrip Fence: swaps route permits for forged cargo claims and attacks when either document is questioned; improvised market armor, hidden tools, and portable trade marks; dark science-fantasy frontier, dramatic lane lighting, full-body readable silhouette, no text
